image_title: Top Benefits of Effective Workplace Safety Programs
summary: This pie chart illustrates the top benefits of effective workplace safety programs as reported by financial decisionmakers, with the data represented in percentages. The largest segment, representing 43%, indicates 'Increased productivity.' The second largest segment, at 28%, corresponds to 'Reduced costs.' A smaller segment, labeled 'Greater retention of employees,' accounts for 7%, while 'Better employee morale and greater job satisfaction' comprises 6%. The 'Other' category is represented by 16%. The chart effectively highlights the perceived advantages of workplace safety initiatives among financial decisionmakers.
